title: Bound on Gaussian elimination work
statement:
Let $r$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a finite variable set, and let an instance of the specified maximum linear constraint system over $ br$'s two-element field have a nonempty multiset of constraints in which every variable occurs. Its Gaussian elimination work is at most
\[m(|V|+1)+|V|m(|V|+2)+|V|(|V|+1),\]
where $m$ is the number of constraints counted with multiplicity.
hypotheses_covered: Every declared variable occurs in some constraint scope
